name: The audit log
description: Admin only: THE AUDIT LOG, every admin write's line -- who, what, on what, when, the reason where one was asked -- newest first, fifty a page, keyset on (at, id). `?admin=` is one admin's handle; `?action=` narrows by prefix (`comment.` is every comment decision, `comment.remove` one kind); `?q=` is a substring of the target or the reason. Read-only: nothing here acts, and every undo made elsewhere is a line of its own. Each write inserts its line in the same statement as the write, so the log and the platform cannot disagree.
